quoteRule: Same exact verified pre-close pair at verified kickoff minus one minute, not older than five minutes, same sides/period, unsuspended. Evaluate winner only on the exact same qualifying subset; do not infer executions or ROI.
limitations: Historical outcomes already inspected by earlier research; exploratory transfer only.

Features for this cohort use frozen previous-day history; runtime updates history causally, so the setting differs.
